limits: Supply is eth_call totalSupply() and decimals() on https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com. totalSupplyRaw is the integer. totalSupply is raw / 10^decimals. A missing decimals() leaves the adjusted supply null.

Holders are GeckoTerminal token-info holders.count (network robinhood), the same integer this desk already shows on the asset page. Calls are one at a time, at least 6.5 seconds apart, because a faster pace receives HTTP 429 on this host. HTTP 429 is retried and is not stored as a count. Blockscout's public API for this chain returned a Cloudflare challenge from the snapshot host, and Routescan tokenholdercount does not index chain 4663 (response: chain not supported). A 404 or a payload with no holders.count stays null. The chain total sums per-token counts and is not unique wallets.
supplyUsd is decimal-adjusted total supply times the desk DexScreener price already on the asset. A missing price or supply leaves supplyUsd null. It is not volume.

Supply is eth_call totalSupply() and decimals() on https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com. totalSupplyRaw is the integer. totalSupply and circulatingSupply are raw / 10^decimals. ERC-20 totalSupply is the outstanding mint; this capture does not see a separate unminted cap. A missing decimals() leaves both supplies null. Issuer treasury and bridge vaults are not subtracted, because this host has no published per-token treasury list for the chain. Those balances stay inside outstanding supply rather than a guessed circulating float.

Holders are GeckoTerminal token-info holders.count (network robinhood), the same integer this desk already shows on the asset page. Calls are one at a time, at least 6.5 seconds apart, because a faster pace receives HTTP 429 on this host. HTTP 429 is retried and is not stored as a count. Blockscout's public API for this chain returned a Cloudflare challenge from the snapshot host, and Routescan tokenholdercount does not index chain 4663 (response: chain not supported). A 404 or a payload with no holders.count stays null. The chain total sums per-token counts and is not unique wallets.

supplyUsd is circulating supply times the desk DexScreener price already on the asset. Circulating supply is the outstanding amount in the unit that price quotes. A missing price, a displayed pool reserve under $1, or an unreadable supply leaves supplyUsd null. It is not volume, and it is not a pool's reported market cap. Issuer treasury, escrow, and bridge balances are not subtracted unless this capture read them. Unreadable balances stay null rather than a guessed float.

notes: GeckoTerminal token info has no holders.count. Blockscout and Routescan did not provide a holder count for this chain.
